def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    A = [0]*(n+1)
    B = [0]*(n+1)
    X = [0]*(n+1)
    idx = 1
    for i in range(1, n):
        A[i] = int(data[idx]); B[i] = int(data[idx+1]); X[i] = int(data[idx+2])
        idx += 3
    INF = float('inf')
    dist = [INF]*(n+1)
    dist[1] = 0
    pq = [(0, 1)]
    while pq:
        d, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if d > dist[u]:
            continue
        if u == n:
            break
        nd = d + A[u]
        if nd < dist[u+1]:
            dist[u+1] = nd
            heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, u+1))
        v = X[u]
        nd = d + B[u]
        if nd < dist[v]:
            dist[v] = nd
            heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, v))
    print(dist[n])

import sys
def main():
    data=sys.stdin.read().split()
    n=int(data[0])
    A=[0]*(n+1);B=[0]*(n+1);X=[0]*(n+1)
    p=1
    for i in range(1,n):
        A[i]=int(data[p]);B[i]=int(data[p+1]);X[i]=int(data[p+2]);p+=3
    S=[0]*(n+1)
    for i in range(1,n):
        S[i+1]=S[i]+A[i]
    # d[i]: min time to reach stage i (via forward chain and jumps)
    INF=float('inf')
    d=[INF]*(n+2)
    d[1]=0
    # cost to finish from stage i by going forward only
    # answer: min over j of d[j]+ (S[N]-S[j]) ; and jumps B_j to X_j with X_j<=j: reach X_j then walk to N
    # Process: best[k] = min over j with X_j=k of (d[j]+B_j) - S[k]
    best=[INF]*(n+2)
    ans=INF
    for i in range(1,n):
        d[i]=min(d[i], best[i]+S[i] if best[i]<INF else INF)
        d[i+1]=min(d[i+1], d[i]+A[i])
        d[X[i]] = min(d[X[i]], d[i]+B[i]) if X[i]>i else d[X[i]]
        if X[i]<=i:
            best[X[i]]=min(best[X[i]], d[i]+B[i]-S[X[i]])
    print(d[n] if d[n]<INF else ans)
